record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
IS_COPY=$1

#加载python环境,持续集成已经设置python环境,不需要再进行设置
#source $UNM_ROOT/server/tool/unmvars.sh

cd $SCRIPT_DIR

#编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
	echo "build nmtool_web failed"
	exit -1
else
	echo "build nmtool_web success"
fi
echo -------build frontend app end------------

#编译后端代码
chmod 777 build_unm_cm_service.sh
sh build_unm_cm_service.sh
exit_status_cm=$?
echo $exit_status_cm
if [ $exit_status_cm -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "build_unm_cm_service failed"
  exit -1
fi

#拷贝到网管环境
if [ $IS_COPY == "true" ];
then
	chmod 777 copy_to_unm2000.sh
	sh copy_to_unm2000.sh
	chmod 777 make_nmtool_src.sh
	sh make_nmtool_src.sh
fi

#! /bin/sh

writelog () {
	local msg=$1
	logger -i -t "Cusaplatform" $msg
}



# mk link 
# param1: target
# param3: linkname
my_mklink () {
    target_path="$1"
    link_path="$2"
    link_dir=${link_path%/*}

    mkdir -p $link_dir
    chmod 755 $link_dir
    my_rmfile $link_path
    ln -s $target_path $link_path
}

echo install Cusaplatform
writelog "install Cusaplatform"

if test $( pgrep -f Cusaplatform |grep 8088 | wc -l ) -gt 1
then
    echo "ERROR:Cusaplatform is runing, please check and stop it before install!"
    writelog "ERROR:Cusaplatform is runing, please check and stop it before install!"
    exit 0
fi


# set Cusaplatform home directory


cusa_home_dir=$(cd $(dirname $0);cd ..; pwd)
thirdparty_dir=$cusa_home_dir/thirdparty

exec="${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/jre/bin/java -Dspring.resources.static-locations=file:${cusa_home_dir}/web -Djava.library.path=${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty -jar ${cusa_home_dir}/lib/admin-service-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar"
#exec="${cusa_home_dir}/bin/start.sh"
exec_str="ExecStart=${exec}"
line=$(sed -n '/ExecStart/=' $cusa_home_dir/bin/cusaplatform.service)
newline=$(expr $line - 1)
sed -i "$line d" $cusa_home_dir/bin/cusaplatform.service 
sed -i "${newline} a\${exec_str}" $cusa_home_dir/bin/cusaplatform.service



#echo init the cusaadmindb
#mysql --socket ${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/mysql_cusa/data/mysql.sock -uroot -pvislecaina <$cusa_home_dir/init/create_table.sql
#mysql --socket ${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/mysql_cusa/data/mysql.sock -uroot -pvislecaina <$cusa_home_dir/init/admin-center.sql
#mysql --socket ${cusa_home_dir}/thirdparty/mysql_cusa/data/mysql.sock -uroot -pvislecaina <$cusa_home_dir/init/auto-deploy.sql


echo install Cusaplatform  services





echo start the cusaplatform service
cp ${cusa_home_dir}/bin/cusaplatform.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/cusaplatform.service

chmod 755 /usr/lib/systemd/system/cusaplatform.service
systemctl enable cusaplatform
systemctl start cusaplatform 
echo service cusaplatform start successfully!
writelog "service cusaplatform start successfully!"
exit

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -x

# If a bundle file is present, call tox with the jenkins version of
# the test environment so it is used.  Otherwise, use the normal
# (non-bundle) test environment.  Also, run pbr freeze on the
# resulting environment at the end so that we have a record of exactly
# what packages we ended up testing.
#
# Usage: run-tox.sh VENV
#
# Where VENV is the name of the tox environment to run (specified in the
# project's tox.ini file).

venv=$1
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

if [[ -z "$venv" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $?"
    echo
    echo "VENV: The tox environment to run (eg 'python27')"
    exit 1
fi

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}

function freeze_venv {
    [ -e $bin_path/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

    echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
    echo "======================================================================"
    ${bin_path}/${freezecmd} freeze | sort -f
    echo "======================================================================"
}

function process_testr_artifacts {
    if [ ! -d ".testrepository" ] ; then
        return
    fi

    if [ -f ".testrepository/0.2" ] ; then
        cp .testrepository/0.2 ./testrepository.subunit
    elif [ -f ".testrepository/0" ] ; then
        $bin_path/testr last --subunit > ./testrepository.subunit
    fi
    #/usr/bin/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    $bin_path/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    SUBUNIT_SIZE=$(du -k ./testrepository.subunit | awk '{print $1}')
    gzip -9 ./testrepository.subunit
    gzip -9 ./testr_results.html

    if [[ "$SUBUNIT_SIZE" -gt 50000 ]]; then
        echo
        echo "testrepository.subunit was > 50 MB of uncompressed data!!!"
        echo "Something is causing tests for this project to log significant amounts"
        echo "of data. This may be writers to python logging, stdout, or stderr."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi

    rancount=$($bin_path/testr last | sed -ne 's/Ran \([0-9]\+\).*tests in.*//p')
    if [ -z "$rancount" ] || [ "$rancount" -eq "0" ] ; then
        echo
        echo "Zero tests were run. At least one test should have been run."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_sudo_usage {
    sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh post
    sudoresult=$?

    if [ $sudoresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to execute commands"
        echo "with sudo.  See above for the exact commands used."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_oom {
    $script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh post
    oomresult=$?

    if [ $oomresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to exceed configured"
        echo "memory limits and was killed prior to completion.  See above"
        echo "for related kernel messages."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_nose_html {
    htmlreport=$(find . -name $NOSE_HTML_OUT_FILE)
    if [ -f "$htmlreport" ]; then

source /etc/profile

# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

if [ -d "/usr/local/nginx" ];then
rm -r /user/local/nginx
fi

chkconfig --del unmstart.server

chkconfig --del unmtoolstart.server

chkconfig --del passtart.server

#Í£Ö¹·þÎñ

/etc/init.d/unmstop.server
/etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmtao.server stop


$UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

#È¡Ïû¿ª»ú×ÔÆô¶¯
chkconfig -d unmactivemq.server
chkconfig -d unmtao.server
result=$(cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
    systemctl disable unm2000.service
    systemctl disable unmtool.service 
    # systemctl disable tomcat.service
else
    chkconfig -del unmstart.server
    chkconfig -del unmtoolstart.server
    # chkconfig -del tomcat.service
fi

#cusaÐ¶ÔØ±ß³µ
revisionfile=$UNM_ROOT/server/etc/revision.txt
grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul
if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/sidecar/bin/uninstall_sidecar_service.sh
fi

# Ð¶ÔØ¹ÜÀí¹¤¾ß
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/scripts/uninstall_nmtool.sh

#Ð¶ÔØnginx
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/uninstall_service.sh

if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
#Ð¶ÔØjetty
sh $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
fi

cd $UNM_ROOT/script
# rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unm.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtool.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtoolstart.server

@ECHO OFF
PUSHD .

SET SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set JAVA_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\java
set JAVAW_CMD=%UNM_ROOT%\platform\jre in\javaw

CD "%SCRIPT_DIR%\.."
FOR /F %%I IN ('CD') DO SET ROOT_DIR=%%I

FOR /F %%I IN ('TYPE "%ROOT_DIR% in\jarfile"') DO SET PACKAGE_NAME=%%I
set MAIN_CLASS=com.fiberhome.service.TelemetryServiceEntry
echo %MAIN_CLASS%
TITLE %PACKAGE_NAME%
if "%1" neq "" (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -DExtYmlUrl="%1" -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"
) else (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%" 
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



cd %SCRIPT_DIR%
echo %cd%
@REM 编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool_web failed"
  exit 1
)
echo -------build frontend app end------------

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success
